title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.33160v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. We call the effort to reduce this bottleneck context scaling. We frame a model as $P_\theta(d\mid c)$ within a system governed by three budgets: training $B_\theta$, decision-time $B_d$, and context-infrastructure $B_c$. Pretraining scaling invests in $\theta$; decision-time scaling searches, refines, or verifies decisions under supplied context; context scaling improves the system's capacity to acquire, represent, deliver, evaluate, and persist deployment state for model use. translated_title: 上下文扩展：AI扩展的新前沿
translated_abstract: 许多已部署AI系统的失败并非源于推理能力薄弱，而是源于任务所依赖的状态与系统行动时可用的上下文之间的不匹配。相关的用户状态、仓库版本、工具调用轨迹、传感器读数或环境变化可能不可用、失真或选择不当。我们将减少这一瓶颈的努力称为“上下文扩展”。我们将模型框架化为 $P_\theta(d\mid c)$，并置于一个由三种预算支配的系统之中：训练预算 $B_\theta$、决策时预算 $B_d$ 和上下文基础设施预算 $B_c$。预训练扩展投资于 $\theta$；决策时扩展在给定上下文下对决策进行搜索、精炼或验证；而上下文扩展则提升系统获取、表示、交付、评估以及持久化部署状态以供模型使用的能力。这三个项目相互作用，但只有 $B_c$ 针对的是系统在决策之前能够提供的内容。这一观点使得“模型-基础设施”组合成为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“上下文扩展”作为AI扩展的新前沿，通过上下文基础设施预算 $B_c$ 提升系统获取、表示、交付和持久化部署状态的能力，以弥合任务所需状态与模型可用上下文之间的鸿沟，从而与预训练扩展和决策时扩展形成互补的三维扩展体系。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "context scaling" as a new frontier of AI scaling, proposing that improving the system's capacity to acquire, represent, deliver, evaluate, and persist deployment state via the context-infrastructure budget $B_c$ addresses the mismatch between task-relevant state and available context, complementing pretraining and decision-time scaling.
